title: Abelian inverse-image section formula
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with singleton isomorphism coverings, finite indexed composition and base-change closure [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and pullbacks along covering arrows. Every covering presieve has finitely many distinct arrows. Every transition functor sends covering presieves to covering presieves and preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ such that a presieve on $Y$ belongs to $Q(Y)$ exactly when it is a transported image of a covering presieve of some $P_j$ along $V_j$. Assume $Q$ has the same finite indexed closure axioms and covering pullbacks. Assume every $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Assume also every transition functor is continuous for the generated topologies. For each stage $i$ and sheaf $G$ on its generated topology there are morphisms $\alpha_t$ from the inverse image along $F(t.hom)$ to the restriction, along $V_{t.right}$, of the inverse image along $V_i$, for every $t$ in $\mathrm{Under}(i)$. The composite of the stage adjunction unit with $\alpha_t$ equals the canonical unit along $V_i$, as an equality in the arrow category (so endpoints are included). For each $U\in F(i)$, there exist a diagram $D$ on $\mathrm{Under}(i)$, component isomorphisms $E_t$ identifying $D(t)$ with the corresponding stage inverse-image sections at $F(t.hom)(U)$, a colimit cocone $K$ and an isomorphism $e$ from its point to the canonical inverse-image sections at $V_i(U)$. The maps $K_t$ followed by $e$ are the section maps of $\alpha_t$ after $E_t$. Each transition $b:t\to t'$ is the section map, after the two $E$ identifications, of a stage sheaf map $\theta_b$ whose composite with the original unit equals the unit at $t'$.Here all sheaves and sections are abelian-group-valued and all maps are additive. No finite-limit or finite-colimit preservation hypothesis on the transition inverse images is required for this section formula.

proof.text: Define the stage transition morphisms as adjuncts of later-stage units, after the cocone composition identification. Injectivity of the adjunction hom equivalence proves identity and composition equations and naturality.

For a general limit object form the category of its stage presentations above i. The representative and eventual equality criteria give common refinements and equalizers of parallel refinements. The under category of any presentation is final. Form the filtered colimit of inverse-image sections; lift restriction arrows and use eventual equality and naturality to prove independence and the presheaf laws.

Lift a Q-cover to a finite stage cover. The assumed covering pullback preservation identifies its sheaf equalizer with the filtered colimit of stage equalizers. Commutation with finite products and equalizers proves that the constructed presheaf is a sheaf. This includes the empty-cover terminal/zero section condition.

Maps from the constructed sheaf to H correspond to compatible stage maps. Stage adjunction identifies these with a single map from G to V_i restriction of H. The reverse map uses the identity presentation and the unit. Uniqueness of adjuncts and the colimit universal property prove the two constructions inverse. The unique unit-compatible left-adjoint isomorphism identifies the construction with sheafPullback, giving alpha and the stated unit equations. The final presentation functor at V_i U gives D, E, K, e and the transition/coprojection equations.

Carry out the presentation colimits and restriction constructions in abelian groups. The forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits and finite limits and reflects isomorphisms, so the same finite sheaf equalizers work. All adjuncts and section maps are additive, and uniqueness of the abelian inverse-image adjoint gives the stated comparison. An empty source stage has no U to evaluate; empty covers impose zero sections.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_inverse_image
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck] :
            (∀ (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
              ∃ α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G),
                (∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app
                      (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                  Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X))) ∧
                ∀ U : F.obj i,
                  ∃ (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
                    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅
                      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
                          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
                    (K : Cocone D)
                    (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
                        (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))),
                    Nonempty (IsColimit K) ∧
                    (∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
                      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
                        (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))) ∧
                    ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                      ∃ θ :
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G),
                        (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              θ.hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))) ∧
                        Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫
                          θ.hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
                        Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom))
